title: Your profile

pay.title: Your pay
pay.label: Yearly salary in US dollars
pay.help: Used only to show how much of your pay sits in each kind of task. Leave empty to use the median for your job.

device.showQr: Show a QR code for my phone

plan.freeBody: Your week map, one free rep and the daily AI or me game.

plan.manageHint: Cancel or change your card on Stripe's secure page.

delete.title: Delete my data
delete.body: Removes your profile and everything in it from Irreplaceable.
delete.list: Your week maps, reps, proof, points and rewards will be deleted. Codes you already received stay valid in Stripe. This can't be undone.
delete.error: We couldn't delete your data. Nothing was removed, so try again.
delete.doneBody: This browser no longer holds your profile. Taking you to the start page.
